scope: A separate default-off device-local inbox-opening permission leaves the existing mute/deafen-only click consent unchanged. The generic inbox action is published only for connected, loaded, owned and currently eligible unread notification indicators.

A precisely shaped non-focusable native child surface sends only an opaque session intent. Native validates sender/frame, exact cursor region, consent and current ready rows; trusted main confirmation consumes a five-second one-shot intent before restoring/showing/focusing the application. Shape failure disables the action with a warning; the passive panel remains click-through.

The main renderer rechecks current owner/auth generation, consent and live notification ACL/preferences before native confirmation and again after awaiting confirmation. This generic action never forwards a notification target, decrypts message content or marks a notification read.
Manual notification navigation now rejects stale owner/generation, blocked actors and inaccessible server/channel/DM/group destinations before read mutations or navigation.
Online-friend and upcoming-event notices now carry additive explicit action metadata without removing old payload fields. Overlay opt-outs also cover historical online title/event_id payloads.
This remains partial P11 notification work: direct overlay replies, calls/invites and independent chat/video/stream widgets are not complete.
